target.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI
target.body:
Closes #93422

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Control UI users who create multiple chat sessions with `/new <name>` would still see raw dashboard session keys instead of useful session names, making parallel sessions hard to distinguish in the picker and session list.

## Why This Change Was Made

Control UI typed commands now route the requested visible name through the existing gateway session `label` source of truth: `/new <name>` forwards the label through the real `ChatPane` session-creation adapter into `sessions.create`, and `/label <name>` patches the active session label. The gateway create/reset path stores the trimmed label, including the `session.dmScope: "main"` reset-in-place case, while avoiding a new writable `displayName` protocol or generated-model contract.

Scope and risk boundaries:

- This PR keeps non-Control-UI command behavior, model routing, auth, archive/pin semantics, transcript format, permissions, dependencies, workflows, generated protocol create/patch `displayName` surfaces, and cross-channel command behavior unchanged.
- Compatibility risk is limited to documenting that Control UI treats bare `/new <text>` as a session-label shortcut; model changes remain directed to `/model`.
- The remaining `/new <text>` grammar choice is intentionally visible for maintainer/product review rather than hidden as a broader command-contract change.

## User Impact

Users can type `/new Research Plan` in Control UI to create a named chat and `/label Work Plan` to rename the current chat. Those labels persist through the gateway session store and appear through the existing session list/display-name path, so users managing multiple parallel dashboard sessions can identify the right session without opening UUID-like keys one by one.

## Evidence

Existing real behavior proof from this PR exercised a local gateway RPC path for `sessions.create` with `label: "Research Plan"`, `sessions.list` filtering by that label, `sessions.patch` changing it to `"Work Plan"`, and a store read confirming the patched `label` persisted. ClawSweeper already marked that proof as sufficient while noting that a visual Control UI recording would still help review.

Fresh verification after resolving the current `origin/main` conflict:

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` passed.
- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-state.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts src/auto-reply/commands-registry.test.ts` passed: 2 Vitest shards, 4 files, 153 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server.sessions.create.test.ts src/gateway/server.sessions.reset-hooks.test.ts -t "sessions.create (trims and stores labels|accepts an explicit key for persistent dashboard sessions|stores dashboard session model and parent linkage|reset-in-place preserves labels)"` passed: 1 file, 3 tests, with the other filtered tests skipped.
- `pnpm tsgo:test:ui` passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:test:src` passed.

Targeted regression coverage now includes:

- typed Control UI `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` command dispatch;
- the real `ChatPane` adapter forwarding `label` to session creation after the split-view refactor;
- gateway label persistence and reset-in-place behavior;
- guarding against fallback, empty-list, synthetic, or updatedAt-only rows being used as new-chat parents.
